run_training: run the JAX-based training loop with a config file, workdir, and dataset settings
resume_training: resume training from an existing checkpoint using the resume config flag
initialize_model: initialize a model from pretrained weights using the model_init config option
evaluate_checkpoint: evaluate a trained model checkpoint by setting total_steps to 1 for inference only
enable_early_stopping: enable early stopping on evaluation metrics to halt training when performance plateaus
